selected.where: s = s.lower() transforms input before checking distinctness
selected.how: Specification examples imply case-sensitive distinctness; lowercasing merges distinct cases like 'A' and 'a'.
selected.what: Input 'AaB' returns False (faulty) instead of True (specified) because 'a' and 'a' are seen as duplicates.

selected.how: range excludes the stop value, so the last group of three characters is never checked for distinctness.
